name: Nekomata na Hibi
source:
This work is a dedication to a pet cat who died, and perhaps it serves as pretty much only that, but... If you were drawn towards the material of this sort of game, then there's no doubt about it, you would seem cursed. Oh well, if we ever meet again someday, then that would be good enough for me...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032857.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
本作是献给一只已经离世的宠物猫的作品，也许它的意义几乎仅止于此……如果你会被这类游戏吸引，那你大概确实被诅咒了吧。算了，若有一天我们还能再相见，那就足够了……

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ032857.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
